entities.summary: Lawrence "Larry" Palmer is an American former ice hockey goaltender. He also attend the United States Military Academy and played ice hockey with the Army Black Knights from 1956 to 1959 before joining the 1960 U.S. Olympic Team with Jack Riley, the head coach of the United States Olympic team. He won a gold medal at the 1960 Winter Olympics.
